nodes.rationale: Auto mendeteksi URL SPIN0ZAi secara case-sensitive. Setelah trim awal whitespace JS, hanya baris addappid(, adddlc(, setManifestid( yang disimpan; baris asli dan indentasi dipertahankan, memakai LF. Footer Lightning pada snapshot ini sudah diganti footer NexaPlay ID.

nodes.label: Flat AppID ZIP Payload

nodes.label: Native Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Retain mature backend behavior while replacing WebView and JavaScript bridge UI with native WinUI.

nodes.label: Private Signing Material Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Private signing material must not be committed to the repository.

nodes.label: Self Signed Publisher Trust
nodes.rationale: A self-signed certificate is trusted only where installed; SmartScreen reputation is separate from signature validity.
nodes.forbidden: Installer automatically adding its certificate to Trusted Root Certification Authorities

nodes.label: Release Only Catalog Seed Refresh
nodes.rationale: Refresh bundled seed from the catalog builder for a release, but never overwrite an existing user runtime database.

nodes.label: Final Signed Installer SHA256
nodes.rationale: Signing changes the installer bytes; generate manifest SHA-256 only from the final signed installer.

nodes.label: Ordered Build And Installer Signing
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding after signing replaces signed files, so signing must be repeated.

nodes.label: Upload Installer Before Update Manifest
nodes.rationale: Publishing a higher manifest version before its installer exists can notify users about an unavailable update.

nodes.label: RTK Output Filtering
nodes.rationale: Prefixing shell commands with RTK compresses command output before model context, reducing token use.

nodes.label: Layered Service Architecture
nodes.rationale: Presentation depends on service contracts while technical operations remain in Infrastructure.

nodes.label: Small Batch Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Small changes followed by build and smoke tests prevent broad XAML failures.

nodes.label: Layout-Cycle-Safe WebView Height Feedback
nodes.rationale: DispatcherQueue defers height assignment outside active WinUI layout pass.

nodes.label: Footer Revision Build Verification
nodes.release_scope: Footer revision did not create publish or installer or change release version.

nodes.label: Telegram Steam Account Reporting
nodes.limit: two successful reports per AppID per UTC date
nodes.privacy: failure logs and dialogs exclude account credentials and request details

nodes.label: Startup License Hardening History
nodes.rationale: Avoid first-run crashes after a cached license becomes banned.

nodes.label: Lua Library Membership
nodes.hydration: SQLite card batch lookup without R2 detail requests

nodes.rationale: Installer preserves the final Lua bytes, active setManifestid, BOM and newline style.

nodes.rationale: Try enabled sources sequentially; six new providers precede GameHub.

nodes.label: Monochrome Native UI Contract
nodes.rationale: Use professional neutral dark surfaces, restrained depth and clear hierarchy; change pages incrementally.
